text:
You need a trainer who can teach Tableau clearly and help clients use it to solve real business problems.

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. While my hands-on project work has been in Power BI, I’ve built training-ready dashboards and translated data into practical business insights for different audiences.

On the Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture, I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model that replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports and cut monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. On the HR attrition dashboard, I built a secure dashboard for 1,900 employees, helping identify attrition hotspots in 2 plants.

I’m comfortable explaining analytical concepts, working with beginners to advanced users, and supporting virtual training sessions during the week.
